first_item.instructions: Name of the first line item, exactly as printed, including any misspellings.

second_item.instructions: Name of the second line item, exactly as printed.

third_item.instructions: Name of the third line item, exactly as printed.

item_lines.instructions: How many line items are listed?

first_item_quantity.instructions: Quantity of the first line item.

subtotal.instructions: Subtotal in rupiah as a plain number; the receipt uses commas as thousands separators, so 12,500 is 12500.

discount.instructions: Discount in rupiah as a plain number; the receipt uses commas as thousands separators, so 12,500 is 12500.

total.instructions: Total in rupiah as a plain number; the receipt uses commas as thousands separators, so 12,500 is 12500.

cash.instructions: Cash tendered in rupiah as a plain number; the receipt uses commas as thousands separators, so 12,500 is 12500.

change.instructions: Change given in rupiah as a plain number; the receipt uses commas as thousands separators, so 12,500 is 12500.

paid_in_cash.instructions: Was the bill paid in cash?

discount_percent.instructions: Discount as a percentage of the subtotal.

change_is_correct.instructions: Does change equal cash minus total?

expense_note.instructions: One short sentence for an expense report describing this purchase and its total.
